senses.gloss: m. pl. (מָלַל II) frail, short-lived people (by the way of play on מַמְלָא, q. v.).—Fem. pl. מַמּוּלְיָאתָא, (מוּלָּיָ׳) מַמּוּלְיָיתָא (with מִילֵּי) frail words (untenable arguments).
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 75b:4">Yeb. 75ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>משום דאַתּוּ מ׳ אמריתו מילי מ׳</he> because you are frail, you speak frail words; (Var. <he>משום דאתיתו מִמּוּלָּאֵי … מוּלָּיָתָא</he> because you are descendants of &c.); <cite ref="Bava Metzia 109a:12">B. Mets. 109ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 137b:7">B. Bath. 137ᵇ</cite> (Ms. R. <he>דאַתּוּן</he>); <cite ref="Bava Batra 151a:6">151ᵃ</cite> (ed. Pes. <he>מַמּוּלְיָאתָה</he>).
